title: Sectionwise inverse image and module transport along a pro-etale scheme isomorphism
statement:
Let $g:X\to Y$ be an isomorphism of schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Use the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] with independent universes as in [def-weil-size-convention]. Define $\Phi_g:X_{\mathrm{proet}}\to Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$ by $(U\xrightarrow{u}X)\mapsto(U\xrightarrow{g\circ u}Y)$, leaving the underlying schemes and arrows unchanged. For a category $D$ with arbitrary object and morphism universes, define the sectionwise model $F_g$ of inverse image [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image] on $D$-valued sheaves by precomposition with $\Phi_g^{\mathrm{op}}$: $(F_g\mathcal F)(U)=\mathcal F(\Phi_g U)$, with the same rule on restriction maps and on morphisms of sheaves. The existing continuity instance of $\Phi_g$ supplies the sheaf condition; no choice of an inverse-image comparison is part of this definition.

For $X,Y$ of universe $t$, an independent coefficient universe $r$, sheaves of rings $R_Y$ on $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$ and $R_X$ on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ valued in $\operatorname{RingCat}_{\max(r,t+1)}$, and a specified isomorphism $c:F_gR_Y\to R_X$, define the module inverse-image functor $G_c:\operatorname{Mod}(R_Y)\to\operatorname{Mod}(R_X)$ on sheaves of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] of universe $\max(r,t+1)$ by $(G_cM)(U)=M(\Phi_g U)$. Its $R_X(U)$-action is $a\cdot x=c_U^{-1}(a)x$; restrictions and module morphisms are evaluated at the same corresponding objects. Equivalently this is the existing sheaf-of-modules pushforward for the continuous functor $\Phi_g$ and the ring map $c^{-1}$.

source.place: Tag 09A5, section-morphism; Tag 00WX, lemma-adjoint-sheaves; Tag 03D2, lemma-pullback-module. The sectionwise model specializes site inverse image to an isomorphism, with module action transported through the specified inverse ring map.
